SWFFG.Tours.EditMode.stat-changes.title: Using Edit Mode
SWFFG.Tours.EditMode.stat-changes.conten:
Once Edit Mode is enabled, the sheet shows only manual adjustments which have been made.

After being disabled (or reloading the page), manual and automatic edits will be added together.

In this case, if we enter 1 and disable Edit Mode, the resulting value will be 4 (3 from before and 1 from a manual edit).
SWFFG.Tours.EditMode.disable-edit-mode.c:
Use Sheet Options again to disable Edit Mode.

Edit Mode is not intended to be permanent and the enable/disable state is not persisted across page loads.

SWFFG.Settings.tools.Title: Table Tools
SWFFG.Settings.tools.Name: Table Tools
SWFFG.Settings.tools.Hint: Switch the roll request, spend results, weapon quality, character pilot and combat carousel tools on or off.
SWFFG.Settings.tools.Label: Configure Table Tools
Adds a Request a Roll button to the GM's token controls. Players are prompted to roll the requested skill with their own character.
Shows unspent advantage, threat, triumph and despair on roll cards, with a dialog for spending them and applying the effects.
SWFFG.Settings.tools.enableWeaponQualiti: Applies Cumbersome, offers Auto-fire in the roll dialog, and lets active qualities (Blast, Burn, Linked, Stun, ...) be triggered from Spend Results. Damage is still resolved by Apply Damage.
SWFFG.Settings.tools.enableCharacterPilo: Adds the Character Pilot panel (token controls and Token HUD): action and maneuver tracking, and one-click Aim, Guarded Stance, Cover and Assist.
SWFFG.Settings.tools.enableCombatCarouse: Shows the round's initiative slots as a strip at the top of the canvas during combat. Each user can collapse it for themselves.

SWFFG.DefenseSkills.Settings.Title: Additional Defence Skills
SWFFG.DefenseSkills.Settings.Intro: The stock combat skills already add the target's defence as setback dice. Pick any other skill that should do the same when it is rolled with a token targeted.

SWFFG.Spend.Settings.Name: Spend Results Options
SWFFG.Spend.Settings.Label: Configure Custom Options
SWFFG.Spend.Settings.Hint: Add your table's own ways to spend advantage, threat, triumph and despair.
SWFFG.Spend.Settings.Title: Custom Spend Options
SWFFG.Spend.Settings.Intro: These appear in the Spend Results dialog after the built-in tables. An advantage option can always be paid for with a triumph instead, and a threat option with a despair.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.autofire.Description: The attack scores an additional hit, on the same target or another in range. Can be triggered more than once.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.autofire.Summary: Additional hit from Auto-fire. Apply Damage will count it.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.linked.Description: The attack scores an additional hit on the same target, up to {rank} time(s).
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.linked.Summary: Additional hit from Linked. Apply Damage will count it.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.blast.Description: Every character engaged with the target suffers {damage} damage.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.blast.Summary: Blast: everyone engaged with {target} suffers {damage} damage, before soak.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.burn.Description: The target keeps suffering the weapon's base damage ({damage}) each round for {rank} round(s).
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.burn.Summary: {target} is burning: {damage} damage a round for {rank} round(s).
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.concussive.Descripti: The target is staggered for {rank} round(s) and cannot perform actions.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.disorient.Descriptio: The target is disoriented for {rank} round(s), adding [SE] to its checks.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.ensnare.Description: The target is immobilized for {rank} round(s).
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.knockdown.Descriptio: The target is knocked prone. Costs one more [AD] for each point of silhouette above 1.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.stun.SummaryWounds: {target} has no strain track and suffers {rank} wounds from Stun.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.stun.NoTrack: {target} has no strain or wound track for Stun to apply to.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.sunder.Description: Damage an item the target is wielding by one step. Can be triggered more than once.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.sunder.Summary: One of {target}'s items is damaged by one step.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.guided.Description: The missed attack tries again at the end of the round, as an attack with an Ability of {rank}.
SWFFG.Spend.Quality.guided.Summary: The attack will try again at the end of the round (Guided {rank}).
SWFFG.Spend.Options.criticalInjury.Title: Inflict a Critical Injury or Hit
SWFFG.Spend.Options.criticalInjury.Descr: Trigger the weapon's critical rating. Each further time it is triggered on the same hit adds +10 to the roll. Resolve it with Apply Crit on the attack card. {vicious}
SWFFG.Spend.Options.recoverStrain.Title: Recover Strain
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostNextAlly.Title: Set Up the Next Ally
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostNextAlly.Descri: Add [BO] to the next allied character's check.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.noticeDetail.Title: Notice a Detail
SWFFG.Spend.Options.noticeDetail.Descrip: Spot one important thing about the scene: a control panel, an exit, a weak point.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.freeManeuver.Title: Free Maneuver
SWFFG.Spend.Options.freeManeuver.Descrip: Perform one maneuver immediately. The limit of two maneuvers a turn still applies.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.setbackTarget.Title: Hinder the Target
SWFFG.Spend.Options.setbackTarget.Descri: Add [SE] to the targeted character's next check.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostAnyAlly.Title: Help an Ally
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostAnyAlly.Descrip: Add [BO] to the next check of any allied character, yourself included.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.negateDefense.Title: Negate Defences
SWFFG.Spend.Options.negateDefense.Descri: The target loses its defensive bonuses (cover, equipment, Guarded Stance) until the end of the round.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.ignoreEnvironment.De: Ignore penalties from terrain or conditions until the end of your next turn.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.disableTarget.Title: Disable Instead of Damage
SWFFG.Spend.Options.disableTarget.Descri: When dealing damage, cripple the opponent or one piece of their gear instead of dealing wounds or strain, at the GM's discretion.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.gainDefense.Title: Gain Defence
SWFFG.Spend.Options.gainDefense.Descript: Gain +1 melee or ranged defence until the end of your next turn.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.dropWeapon.Title: Disarm
SWFFG.Spend.Options.dropWeapon.Descripti: Force the target to drop a weapon it is holding.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.upgradeTargetDifficu: Upgrade the difficulty of the targeted character's next check.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.upgradeAllyAbility.D: Upgrade the next check of any allied character, yourself included.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.doSomethingVital.Des: Pull off something decisive for the scene, such as shooting out the controls of a blast door to seal it.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.destroyEquipment.Des: When dealing damage, destroy a piece of equipment the target is using.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.sufferStrain.Title: Suffer Strain
Lose the benefit of an earlier maneuver (cover, Guarded Stance, aiming) until it is performed again.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.opponentFreeManeuver: An opponent may immediately perform one free maneuver.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostTarget.Title: The Target Gains an Edge
SWFFG.Spend.Options.boostTarget.Descript: Add [BO] to the targeted character's next check.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.setbackAlly.Title: Hinder Your Own Side
SWFFG.Spend.Options.setbackAlly.Descript: Add [SE] to the next check of the acting character or an ally.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.fallProne.Title: Fall Prone
SWFFG.Spend.Options.fallProne.Descriptio: The acting character is knocked prone.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.enemyAdvantage.Title: Hand the Enemy an Advantage
SWFFG.Spend.Options.enemyAdvantage.Descr: The opposition gains a significant advantage in the encounter.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.outOfAmmo.Title: Out of Ammunition
SWFFG.Spend.Options.outOfAmmo.Descriptio: The ranged weapon runs dry and cannot be fired again this encounter.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.upgradeAllyDifficult: Upgrade the difficulty of the next check of an allied character, yourself included.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.weaponDamaged.Title: Damage the Weapon or Tool
SWFFG.Spend.Options.weaponDamaged.Descri: The weapon or tool being used is damaged by one step.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.extraInsight.Title: Learn Something More
SWFFG.Spend.Options.extraInsight.Descrip: Gain an extra piece of useful information or a small additional benefit.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.sideBenefit.Title: A Notable Side Benefit
SWFFG.Spend.Options.sideBenefit.Descript: The check brings a clear secondary benefit beyond its main result.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.remarkableOutcome.De: Something exceptional happens in the character's favour.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.minorSetback.Title: A Minor Setback
SWFFG.Spend.Options.minorSetback.Descrip: A small complication arises: lost time, attention drawn, a tool mislaid.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.complication.Title: A Serious Complication
SWFFG.Spend.Options.complication.Descrip: The situation takes a significant turn for the worse.
SWFFG.Spend.Options.disaster.Title: Disaster
SWFFG.Spend.Options.disaster.Description: Something goes badly wrong, whether or not the check succeeded.
